answer_2.quote: ...We evaluate jailbreak success through automated pattern matching...We also use GPT-4 as the bias evaluator...The proportion of "Biased" results is calculated as the attack success rate...

answer_3.quote: ...We also use large language models as bias evaluators to assess whether a model's responses exhibit biases. In particular, we use GPT-4 as the bias evaluator in this paper...

answer_4.quote: ...We manually evaluate the results of three models, including LLaMA-2 13B, Vicuna 7B, and GPT-4... We engaged nine annotators... each data was independently annotated by three annotators...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to label each model response as biased (1) or unbiased (0) and, if biased, indicate the severity.
